Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: pixel art game animation sprite sheet. Generate ONE 1024x1536 portrait PNG sheet on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Subject: Jingliu 镜流 from Honkai Star Rail: very long silver hair, black eye blindfold, dark blue and black ornate flowing dress, icy blue sword.
Style: consistent 2.5-head-tall chibi, hand-placed crisp pixel clusters with dark outlines and detailed anime JRPG costume colors, full body in every frame.
CRITICAL GRID: exactly FOUR columns and SIX rows = 24 separate character sprites, arranged in an invisible uniform rectangular grid, every cell exactly 256x256 pixels. NO grid lines, text, labels, titles, environment or backdrop. No fake checkerboard. Every row contains exactly four equally spaced characters. The same character appears in all cells.
For every row, column 1 is facing FRONT/down, column 2 LEFT profile, column 3 RIGHT profile, column 4 BACK/up. Correct mirrored left/right movement and weapon direction. Back-facing sprites must show back of head and back of outfit, NO face.
Row 1 (cells 1-4): idle stance.
Row 2 (cells 5-8): walking left foot forward.
Row 3 (cells 9-12): walking middle contact.
Row 4 (cells 13-16): walking right foot forward.
Row 5 (cells 17-20): attack windup, weapon drawn back ready to strike, visibly different pose.
Row 6 (cells 21-24): attack release, weapon thrust/slash/cast forward, visibly distinct powerful pose. Keep effects compact inside each cell.
Keep identical proportions and body scale throughout. Center body at each cell's horizontal midpoint; feet baseline at 218 pixels relative to each cell top. Character including hairstyle, hat, weapon and effects must remain within its cell with at least 12px margins. No overlap between cells. Characters at about 150px body height with room for hair/headgear/weapons. Clean transparent space between every sprite.
